verdict.rationale: Aircall ships AI Agents and AI Assistants that act across business tools, so asking whether it can act as an MCP client is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or connecting external MCP servers. The Shopify, Stripe, calendar and CRM actions (aircall-docs-21) are built-in integrations, an adjacent feature rather than MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
